_about: Data for the samosa station (design system §15), the combined station js/cook/stations/samosa.js: six pastry strips on the board at every level (SAM-25): tap any, fill it from the shelf's filling heaps (a spoonful per tap), one tick when done; then fold each filled strip by swiping (SAM-21: the coded fold in the pastry texture, js/cook/mechanics/fill-fold.js Cook.Pastry), then fry them in the karahi on the kitchen kit's wide hob and lift each onto the paper-lined plate when golden. Serve and taste (§14a). Its own numbers are here (art, grid; STD-F1-03): the code reads them, never its own copies. The fill's decoys are the level table's, the fold's swipes data.mechanics.fold (folds, minLen), the fry's speed and golden band data.mechanics.fry (by level). `phases`: one English line per job for the grown-ups (placeholders, like every station goal) and the phase button's label.

station.name: Samosa
station.goal: Fill as many strips as they asked for with what they said, fold each one, then fry them golden: each step moves on by itself.

phases.fill: Tap a strip, then the fillings: one spoon each tap, as many spoons as they said. Fill as many strips as they asked for: it moves on by itself.
phases.fold: Swipe the way the arrow shows to fold each samosa. Then they go to the karahi.
phases.fry: Turn on the hob, put the samosas in, and lift each one out when it's golden.

art._about: Samosa's own pictures (decision 68: loaded when samosa is chosen, each at its one drawn size) and what build/cut_cook_v3.py measured on them (assets/cook/items/v3/samosa/meta.json; fractions of each sprite, checked by build/check_vessel_meta.py). heaps: each filling's top-down heap (S2 / Q2, no bowls; 30 Sept: the chilli is daar's sliced rings; ART-11: the potato is the landed PT1 pile). pastry: the tile the coded fold is drawn in (SAM-21). fry: raw, light, golden, too dark (S19, s19-wave-e2: S4 #97, the closed samosa in four stages, cut by build/tools/art/s19_cut.py; was samosa-v2's). under: the round sheet's underside (S2 #92), shown by a flap of the coded fold seen from below (Cook.Pastry's under). meta: karahi (its round body, handles left out; oil = the oil's radius / the body's), plate (its rim; flat = the paper-lined centre's half-width / the rim r), jharo (its bowl's middle and radius: x, r of the width, y of the height), heap and fry (their canvases).

karahi._k3: the k3 run's K8r-2 (11 Nov), measured on the cut (build/reports/s19-k3-cut.md): the rim's centre and radius; the oil's own centre sits about 10 px below the rim's (a deep karahi's wall shows wider at the top), the samosas float within 0.8 of the oil round the rim's centre (SAM-14)

spoon._sam34: SAM-34 (Zafar, 9 Nov, round 2: the slotted spoon on its folded cloth kept, wood and metal; B3-3): the run's K6b, straight down, 273 x 700; its bowl's middle (bx, by: of the width and height) and radius (br, of the width), measured on the picture; cut: the row (of the height) from which only the walnut handle is kept, the cloth under it cleared in code (js/cook/stations/samosa.js spoonTex), so the spoon lifts off the cloth (kit/cloth stays)

colours._about: the hot oil's shimmer, its bubbles and the puff as a samosa drops in; a filling's puff when its own word has no layer colour

art._s19k2: S19 (s19-games-1; the kitchen-and-items run, 11 Nov): karahi is the run's K8, the karahi with oil straight down (v4/samosa/karahi-oil; a redo keeps its name and box, ART-75), measured on the cut: body cx, cy, r (of w, handles left out) and oil (the oil's radius, 305 px, over the body's, 394); plate is S5, the cream plate with its paper napkin (v4/samosa/plate-napkin, ART-71), its rim's circle (421 px of 896) and flat: the napkin's square middle over the rim's radius.

items._ck82: CK-82 (the eye judge, 10 Nov: 'the order card's chundo picture matches the shelf's'; the coordinator, 10 Nov: a game's own items[].card wins, the card shows what the child taps): each filling's card on the order is its heap as it lies on the band (art.heaps), read by js/cook/ui.js cardOfIds

grid._about: Where samosa's things sit, in the 1600x900 design box (chai v2's grid; the band is the bottom 30%, St.SHELF). heapY, chipY, pitch, heapW, shelfSpan: the heaps on the band and their pills, the row centred in the span (clear of the tick, bottom right; the shared kit's Shelf.slots) (SH-112: a quarter bigger, centred between the band's top gap and the chips). board: the house board (S6; board.webp is 1397 x 847, so h = w x 847 / 1397), bigger for six strips (SAM-25, P43) and its foot above the band. plate: where the folded ones wait (S10). strips: six at every level (SAM-25); stripH: a strip's height at full size; ppu: the fold's canvas px per strip height. fry (S17, S19, Q9): the wide hob's scale and middle, the karahi's body radius (237: at 270 its rim ran over the knob; SH-112: 5% smaller), the plate right of the hob, the raw ones' thalis on the band. oil: a samosa's size in the oil and where they float (degrees round the middle, r a fraction of the oil's radius), by how many fry (the first whose upTo holds; SAM-14: a spot plus half its size stays within 0.8 of the oil).

fry._sam34: SAM-34 (Zafar, 9 Nov: 'a button to turn on the fryer ... off to the left-hand side, so that the frying pan can remain bigger'; decision 2026-11-09-tiers-flash-merge #5: 'one hob in chai's proportions'; round 2's B3-3, sources/art/s19-mocks2/results/B3-samosa-3-fry.png): chai's one-burner hob with its knob and face on the left (the kit's knobs 'left', SH-247), the spoon on its cloth beside it, then the plate, one row centred in the view above the band. hobH: the hob's height at most (design px; less where the row must fit the view's width); karahi: the karahi's body radius as a share of the hob's height; spoon, plate: their heights as shares of the hob's; gap: between the three.

grid._oil_s19k2: S19 (s19-games-1): the v4 karahi's oil is 0.774 of its body (the v3 one's 0.90): the samosas in it are a little smaller and float nearer the middle (SAM-14: a spot plus half its size within 0.8 of the oil); with the plate (pd 360, its napkin's middle 0.66 of the rim) a samosa keeps its size from the thali to the oil to the plate within 15% (contract-114)
